wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
tips: Choose from 9 bundled preset wallpapers or upload your own images (JPG/PNG/WebP, max 10MB).
Background images work best with an opacity of 0.6–0.8 for good readability.

colors.title: Fonts & colors
tips: Primary text color applies to the dim and night themes. A secondary color is still stored for optional use — switch themes with the ☀/🌙 control in the sidebar to preview.
Hex input and color picker are synchronized — you can type exact color values directly.

layout.title: Layout & columns
tips: Service columns (2–10) and shortcut columns (2–8) can be configured independently.

widgets.title: Widgets
tips: Individual widgets (Clock, Weather, Spotify) can be hidden without losing the configuration.

weather.title: Weather
tips: Weather widget: The city is resolved via geocoding — shows you country, postal code and coordinates for confirmation.
Weather data is automatically updated every 2 hours. Manual refresh via the widget button is possible.

connection.title: Connection & API
tips: Use a dedicated API token with minimal permissions (PVEAuditor) or PVEAdmin if VMs need to be controlled. Format: user@realm!tokenname
API token secrets are stored encrypted with Fernet (AES-128) and never shown in plaintext.
SSL verification can be disabled — useful for self-signed certificates in homelabs.
In cluster mode all nodes are detected automatically. Optional: Set a specific node as filter.
Save the connection first, then test — the test shows the number of found nodes.

dashboard.title: Monitoring dashboard
tips: Auto-refresh interval configurable: 15s / 30s / 60s / 120s — shorter intervals = more API calls.
Monitoring settings (Refresh, Top-Items, Time Range) are browser-local and do not sync between devices.

config.title: Config import / export
tips: Config export saves: Dashboards, Services, Shortcuts & Appearance. Filename: servicedock-config-YYYY-MM-DD.json
For security reasons Proxmox and Spotify credentials are never exported.
Import mode "Append" adds data (IDs are reassigned). "Replace" deletes everything first.
Before import the file is validated and a preview is shown (number of Dashboards, Services, Shortcuts).
Always make an export backup before using the "Replace" mode!

spotify.title: Spotify
tips: Spotify requires an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard. The Redirect URI is automatically detected.
Spotify has read-only access — only the current song is queried.
OAuth connection: 2 minute timeout. Checked automatically every 3 seconds. On timeout simply reconnect.

ldap.title: AD / LDAP
tips: Connect Microsoft Active Directory or OpenLDAP via the LDAP add-on (save and test bind credentials there).
When LDAP is enabled, local user management may be restricted — use your directory for day-to-day accounts.
Prefer a dedicated bind account with read access to users and groups only.

dashboards: Create separate dashboards for different environments — e.g. Home, Work, Gaming, Media or Development.
Each dashboard is completely independent: its own services, shortcuts and Proxmox configuration.
Dashboard names and descriptions can be changed at any time without data loss.
The Proxmox tab can be enabled/disabled per dashboard individually — saves space when not needed.
The last dashboard cannot be deleted — at least one must always exist.
When deleting a dashboard, all associated services and shortcuts are also removed.
language: The language is automatically detected based on your browser settings.
Your language preference is saved in the browser and persists across sessions.
All UI text switches instantly — no page reload needed.
users: Admins can create viewer or admin accounts stored in the database (no LDAP required).
With more than one local user, the login screen requires a username.
You cannot remove or disable the last active admin. Use Reset password if someone forgot theirs.
help: Guides are Markdown files from the Servicedock repository, served read-only via the API.
Use the list on the left to switch topics. External links in docs open in a new tab.
If a file is missing on the server, that entry may fail to load until the deployment includes it.
